cards.title: A great old-timey game-programming hack (2013)

depth.text: someone made a **choppy old game** run **smoothly** with a wild **graphics-copying hack**

The 6809 used **pull-and-push instructions** to copy **seven-byte chunks**; a one-time tile preprocessing step reversed the septet order to undo the upside-down, swapped result.
